title: Image Serverless — FLUX.2 klein 4B / Qwen-Image-2512 / Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 / i2i
description: ComfyUI serverless worker for image keyframes: text-to-image with FLUX.2 klein 4B and Qwen-Image-2512, instruction/mask editing and i2i style-reference with Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 (all Apache-2.0). It executes a prepared ComfyUI API graph built by the video_gen catalog (it never builds or edits the graph), accepts base image and mask as presigned assets, and returns the generated PNG plus execution-fact telemetry (GPU, seconds, size, model, seed, steps, cfg, sampler, scheduler). Models download to your network volume on first boot from pinned Hugging Face commits.

input.name: Auto-download models
input.description: Download the models listed in models-manifest.txt to the attached network volume at worker boot. Requires a network volume of at least 100 GB (the pinned set is ~66.7 GB).

input.name: Volume verification mode
input.description: fast (default) — trust the recorded size+mtime in models/.populate-state.tsv, so a warm cold start is seconds instead of reading 66.7 GB; full — read sha256 of every file before the handler starts (~4.5 min); off — skip the check (debug only).

input.name: Background sha256 verification
input.description: After the handler starts, verify every model against its pinned sha256 in the background ([populate-verify] in the log) and repair mismatches via quarantine + re-download. Keeps full verification on every boot without blocking the cold start.

input.name: Hugging Face token
input.description: Optional — only needed if you replace the public models in models-manifest.txt with gated Hugging Face repositories.

input.name: Job timeout (seconds)
input.description: Maximum time a single image job may run before the worker aborts it. Must be less than or equal to the endpoint timeout (600–900 s is the image-stand target).

input.name: ComfyUI boot timeout (seconds)
input.description: How long the worker waits for the local ComfyUI server to become ready.

input.name: Use custom nodes from the volume
input.description: Symlink custom_nodes from /runpod-volume/custom_nodes into ComfyUI. Leave disabled: FLUX.2 klein, Qwen-Image-2512 and Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 are covered by ComfyUI core in the image.

input.name: S3 endpoint
input.description: Optional S3/MinIO endpoint. Configure S3_* to return large images as presigned image_url instead of inline base64.

input.name: S3 access key
input.description: S3/MinIO access key (secret — endpoint env only).

input.name: S3 secret key
input.description: S3/MinIO secret key (secret — endpoint env only).

input.name: S3 bucket
input.description: Bucket for large image output (alias: OUTPUT_BUCKET).

changelog:
## v1.2.1

- GPU pools: `gpuIds` widened from `AMPERE_48,ADA_48_PRO` to `AMPERE_48,ADA_48_PRO,AMPERE_80,BLACKWELL_96`. A Hub build failed with "no instances available for your specified GPU NVIDIA RTX A6000 nor on any of the fallback GPUs NVIDIA A40, NVIDIA L40": the 48 GB pools were empty at that moment, so the fallback list now includes A100 80 GB (`AMPERE_80`) and RTX PRO 6000 96 GB (`BLACKWELL_96`) — both already in the project GPU registry and the 13-image-stand proposal. 48 GB cards stay first in the list: they are the cheapest sufficient option, the larger cards are fallback for availability, not the default.
- The Hub build test now requests `NVIDIA A100 80GB PCIe` instead of `NVIDIA RTX A6000`: the test only boots the image and runs the health action (no weights are loaded, `VOLUME_AUTOPOPULATE=false`), so a larger, more available pool is a safer target; the production endpoint pool is unchanged in order and still prefers 48 GB.
- Docs: worker README (deploy/requirements/risks), `docs/DEPLOY.md` and the image-stand GPU policy note mention the wider pool and the CUDA 13.x constraint.
- No worker code, contract (`image-serverless/v1`), manifest or populate/verify behaviour changes.

## v1.2.0

- Cold start: the volume is no longer re-read in full at every boot. `populate-volume.sh` records `<sha256>`, size and mtime in `models/.populate-state.tsv`; with `VERIFY=fast` (default) an unchanged file is trusted after a few `stat` calls instead of reading 66.7 GB (~4.5 min, 94% of the boot measured in a real worker log). Rows written by older versions have no mtime: such a file is hashed once, then upgraded in place (no re-download, no manual migration).
- The full sha256 check still runs on every boot, but after the handler starts: `entrypoint.sh` starts a second pass with `VERIFY=full` (`[populate-verify]`, `nice`/`ionice`, stopped on SIGTERM) and repairs what it finds. `VOLUME_BACKGROUND_VERIFY=false` disables it, `VOLUME_VERIFY=full` restores the old blocking behaviour, `off` skips checking (debug only).
- A file whose sha256 does not match its pin is moved to `<file>.corrupt-<UTC>` and re-downloaded: ComfyUI never sees known-bad weights (the job fails visibly instead of generating from corrupted bytes), the quarantined bytes stay for diagnosis if the re-download fails and are removed after the verified replacement is in place.
- The volume flock is now taken only around mutations (download, quarantine, state write), never around hashing, so a background check in one worker does not stall another worker's boot.
- Fixed the download-failure log line, which reported `curl exit 0` (inside `if ! curl` the `$?` value is the result of the negation).
- Contract `image-serverless/v1` and worker code are unchanged.

## v1.1.2

- Volume manifest: Qwen-Image-2512 t2i diffusion weights (`qwen_image_2512_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors`, 20.43 GB, Apache-2.0) are auto-downloaded on first boot. It reuses the existing Qwen-Image text encoder and VAE, so the pinned volume set grows from ~46.3 GB to ~66.7 GB; the documented minimum network volume is now 100 GB.
- The worker image code, contract (`image-serverless/v1`) and schemas are unchanged: Qwen-Image-2512 runs on ComfyUI core nodes (`UNETLoader`, `CLIPLoader(type=qwen_image)`, `VAELoader`, `EmptySD3LatentImage`, `ModelSamplingAuraFlow`, `KSampler`, `VAEDecode`), no custom-node package is added.
- README/model catalogs document the Qwen-Image-2512 t2i graph and the new volume size; telemetry remains the same (`model_name` is the file name from `model_files`).

## v1.1.1

- Volume populate: a failing `sha256sum` (for example `ERANGE` on a 20 GB file on the network volume) is no longer treated as a corrupted download — the `.tmp` file is kept for the next attempt and an empty state hash is never recorded. Previously a transient tool/filesystem error deleted a 20.5 GB download and forced a full re-download on the next cold start.
- Graph docs/examples: the FLUX.2 example now uses `EmptyFlux2LatentImage` (FLUX.2 has a 128-channel latent; `EmptySD3LatentImage` fails at the sampler) and shows the required `UNETLoader.weight_dtype`. The catalog-graph section documents `{{model_file}}` (pinned file names from `model_files`), split loaders (`CLIPLoader` types `flux2` / `qwen_image`), the edit pipeline (base/mask assets, `ImageScale` to the snapshot canvas, optional mask), the i2i branch, and the `KSampler` vs native `Flux2Scheduler` telemetry limit.
- Operability: README documents the RunPod `policy.ttl` (it must cover queue + execution; the video_gen app sends 3600 s) and that a `404` from `/v2/{endpoint}/status/{run}` means the run is not registered for that endpoint (recreated endpoint / expired run), not a graph error; pre-populate the volume before sending jobs.
- Version metadata aligned at `1.1.1`: worker `__version__` (it reported 1.0.0 while the package was 1.1.0), `pyproject.toml`, Dockerfile `IMAGE_WORKER_VERSION` and Hub metadata.
- No contract (`image-serverless/v1`) or schema changes: the worker still executes the prepared ComfyUI API graph unchanged.

## v1.1.0

- i2i / style reference: a reference image is delivered as a presigned asset and used as the init image (LoadImage → ImageScale → VAEEncode → KSampler with denoise below 1.0); the new contract example is `contract/examples/request-i2i.json`.
- Build-time verification of the core i2i nodes (`ImageScale`, `VAEEncode`, `TextEncodeQwenImageEdit`); no new custom-node package or weights are required.
- Worker contract §1.2 documents image-to-image and the style-reference asset; README and model catalog instructions updated.
- Additive within `image-serverless/v1`; the input/output schemas are unchanged.

## v1.0.0

- Initial release: ComfyUI serverless image worker (contract `image-serverless/v1`) for the video_gen keyframe step.
- Executes a prepared ComfyUI API graph unchanged; returns PNG + execution-fact telemetry (gpu_cc/gpu_class, seconds, width/height, model_name, seed, steps, cfg, sampler, scheduler).
- Edit pipeline: base image and mask delivered as presigned assets into the ComfyUI input directory with sha256/size verification.
- Network-volume model auto-download (`models-manifest.txt`, `VOLUME_AUTOPOPULATE`): FLUX.2 klein 4B and Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 pinned to immutable Hugging Face commits with sha256.
- Optional S3 presigned `image_url` delivery for large results.
